name: Builder Definition Stage Analysis Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for a Threat Model Spec Analysis Report produced at the Builder Definition PDLC stage.

categories.name: Trust Boundary Coverage
categories.description: Whether the diagram identifies every place attacker-controlled input crosses into a more-trusted zone.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Every external-entity-to-process flow crosses a declared trust boundary

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most boundaries declared but at least one external-facing flow crosses no boundary

options.label: Fail
criteria: No trust boundaries declared despite external-facing components

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does every flow from an external-entity element cross at least one declared trust boundary?

categories.name: Threat Completeness
categories.description: Whether STRIDE/LINDDUN threats are systematically applied to every boundary-crossing flow, not just an arbitrary subset.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Every boundary-crossing flow has at least one STRIDE-mapped Finding of type threat-candidate

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most flows covered but at least one boundary-crossing flow has no threat mapping

options.label: Fail
criteria: Flows exist that cross a trust boundary with no threat analysis at all

categories.evaluationPrompt: Is there at least one Finding (type threat-candidate) for every flow that crosses a trust boundary?

categories.name: Control Mapping
categories.description: Whether every validated threat has at least one proposed Mitigation.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Every validated threat-candidate Finding has a specific, actionable Mitigation

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most threats have mitigations but a required control is missing or generic

options.label: Fail
criteria: Threats identified with no corresponding mitigation

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does every validated threat-candidate Finding have at least one specific, actionable Mitigation, not a generic 'add validation'?

categories.name: API Contract Drift Check
categories.description: Whether the report checks the finalized API contract against Product Definition's advisory draft.

options.label: Pass
criteria: An ArchitectureAssertion compares the finalized contract to the Product Definition draft with evidence on both sides

options.label: Partial
criteria: Drift mentioned narratively but not recorded as an ArchitectureAssertion

options.label: Fail
criteria: No comparison to the Product Definition draft at all, despite one existing

categories.evaluationPrompt: When a Product Definition OpenAPI draft exists, does the report record an ArchitectureAssertion comparing it to the finalized contract?
